import pandas as pd

# Read input file
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Separate metadata columns from indicator columns
metadata_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in metadata_cols]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missing_counts = df[indicator_cols].isna().sum()
total_rows = len(df)
missing_rates = missing_counts / total_rows

# Create missingness report with kept indicator
kept = missing_rates <= 0.30
report_data = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_cols,
    'missing_count': missing_counts.values,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates.values,
    'kept': kept.values
})

# Write missingness report (RFC 4180 compliant by default with pandas)
report_path = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
report_data.to_csv(report_path, index=False)

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_indicator_cols = indicator_cols[kept]

# Create selected matrix with metadata + kept indicators
selected_df = df[metadata_cols + selected_indicator_cols]

# Write selected matrix (RFC 4180 compliant by default with pandas)
selected_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
selected_df.to_csv(selected_path, index=False)
